items.title: Russian court freezes 57 million rubles in defence procurement corruption case
items.summary: Russia's Investigative Committee said a Rostov court seized property, cash and bank accounts worth 57 million rubles belonging to three defendants, including former Zvezda-Strela director Alexander Shafranovich. Investigators allege the group inflated prices for defence-related products, misappropriating more than 110 million rubles, and engaged in bribery; the allegations remain before the courts.

items.title: Russian marines reportedly intercept Ukrainian DARTS attack drone
items.summary: A Russian military-linked report says an interceptor drone called Yolka, operated by Russia's 40th Marine Brigade, struck a Ukrainian DARTS fixed-wing attack drone as it descended toward a target. The account describes an interception but does not identify the location or report further damage.
